name: Adzviser Pipedrive
description:
Connect your Pipedrive data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files, Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about deals won, revenue, and activities. Compare pipelines, dig into stage and deal owner performance, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking this week's pipeline or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser Pipedrive to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser Pipedrive to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://pipedrive.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser Pipedrive MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Pipedrive provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_pipedrive, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser Pipedrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser Pipedrive in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser Pipedrive MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Pipedrive requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser Pipedrive is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
